runtime.tunUnavailable: Tunnel mode is unavailable: it needs the app to be started as administrator. Use Proxy mode instead.

proxy.strictUnavailable: The strict kill switch is not available in Proxy mode: it needs WFP filters (Tunnel mode, started as administrator).
proxy.notAccepting: The engine's local proxy does not accept connections on port {{port}}.

proxyMode.proxyDown: Proxy {{addr}} does not respond. Programs that use the system proxy get no connection until it answers again; other programs connect directly.
proxyMode.upstreamDown: The VPN through server «{{name}}» is not confirmed. Programs that use the system proxy may get no connection; other programs connect directly. Check the connection or choose another server.
proxyMode.slotExited: The server's xray-core exited; restarting it. Programs that use the system proxy wait until it is back.

soft.strictUnavailable: The strict kill switch is not available in Proxy mode. Choose Standard or Off, or Tunnel mode.

softConnected.title: Proxy mode on
softConnected.body: Programs that use the Windows system proxy go through the VPN; other programs connect directly.

softBlocked.title: The VPN engine stopped
softBlocked.body: The system proxy still points at the stopped engine: programs that use it get no connection until you turn protection on again or off. Other programs connect directly.

softPaused.title: System proxy paused
softPaused.body: The VPN engine restarts in {{seconds}} s: the server has to wait out a block. Until then programs connect directly, without the VPN; the proxy comes back with the connection.

softResumeFailed.title: System proxy not restored
softResumeFailed.body: The VPN engine runs again, but the system proxy could not be pointed at it: programs connect directly, without the VPN. Turn protection off and on again.

softRestored.title: Proxy mode stopped
softRestored.body: The VPN engine stopped. The system proxy was restored: programs connect directly, without the VPN.
